subject.title: feat: let agents remember across private conversations

question: Should OpenClaw ship this new default-off per-agent mode for retrieving same-agent private transcript context, with Memory Core as the protected authorization path and other memory providers excluded from that product flow?
rationale: The mechanical doctor repair is clear, but whether this privacy-sensitive configuration becomes a supported core product contract cannot be decided from code correctness alone.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded core mode
options.body: Approve the documented default-off same-agent-private recall contract after the doctor guard lands and retain the explicit provider limitation.

options.title: Narrow or defer the contract
options.body: Keep the underlying advanced recall paths but defer this user-facing setting until maintainers want a broader provider or identity model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded core mode
recommendation.body: Approve the documented default-off same-agent-private recall contract after the doctor guard lands and retain the explicit provider limitation.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignment and maintainer implementation notes connect this person most directly to the recall, provider, and doctor design decisions.
